d: US Attorney General Todd Blanche has described Nvidia as a “good corporate citizen” while facing questions about potential federal investigations involving the AI chipmaker and its CEO, Jensen Huang. Blanche declined to clarify whether the Justice Department had investigated Huang before President Donald Trump backed his return as Nvidia CEO. Huang was reinstated on November 23, less than two weeks after stepping down amid controversy over his reported relationship with a woman suspected of having links to Chinese intelligence.
